title: Caring for our bodies every day
summary: Learn to care for your body with good food, cleanliness, exercise and rest.
keyIdeas: Eating fruit and vegetables helps give us energy and keep us healthy.
Washing hands with soap and water helps prevent illness.
Sleeping well and exercising help us grow strong.

basicKnowledge: A. Cultura científica › La vida en nuestro planeta

activities.prompt: Drinking water during the day is good for our bodies.
activities.explanation: Water keeps us hydrated and helps our bodies work well.

activities.prompt: Which food is the best choice for a break-time snack?
activities.explanation: Fruit contains vitamins and gives us energy to play.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence about caring for teeth.
activities.explanation: Brushing removes food and helps prevent tooth decay. We brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste, including before bed.
activities.hint: Think about breakfast, lunch and dinner.
activities.sentence: After a ___, bits of food may remain between our teeth.

activities.prompt: Put the steps for washing hands with soap in order.
activities.explanation: First wet your hands, then rub with soap, rinse and dry.
items: Rinse away the soap with water
Dry your hands with a clean towel

activities.explanation: Rest and exercise help our health. Too much screen time can affect it.

items.text: Sleep for ten hours at night
Play video games for four hours without a break
Ride a bike in the park

activities.prompt: Match each action to how it helps our health.
activities.explanation: Different habits help us feel well in different ways.

activities.prompt: Find the mistake. Which idea is false?
activities.explanation: Microbes are too small to see with our eyes. That is why we need to wash our hands.
activities.hint: Some things are too tiny to see without a special tool.
options: Outdoor exercise helps keep bones strong
If our hands look clean, they never have microbes

activities.prompt: The class compares washing with water and washing with soap and water. What should they keep the same for a fair comparison?
activities.explanation: Use the same amount of dirt and wash for the same time. Then we can compare the effect of soap.
activities.hint: Change only the thing you want to compare.
options: The amount of dirt and the washing time
Wash once at home and once in the playground

activities.prompt: Read about Omar's day and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Omar cares for his health with movement, varied food and good rest.
activities.title: Omar's active day
activities.text: Omar has milk, oats and banana for breakfast. He walks to school with his mother. At break, he plays tag with Martina. Later, he runs in the park and eats an apple. At home, he showers and has an omelette with salad. By nine at night, he is asleep.

questions.prompt: How does Omar get to school?
questions.explanation: The text says he walks, which gives him some morning exercise.
Omar combines varied food, exercise, cleanliness and rest.
options: He eats well, moves a lot and goes to bed early
He only eats sweets and drinks fizzy drinks

activities.prompt: Lucía feels sleepy in class and finds it hard to pay attention. Which change could help her most?
activities.explanation: Getting enough sleep and avoiding screens before bed can help her rest.
activities.hint: Think about sleeping better at night.
options: Watch cartoons on a tablet until midnight
Have a very sugary drink before class
Go to bed earlier and stop using screens an hour before bed
